neighbours.label: the name stem Cyril / Kirill, including Cyrillic and the Russian spelling Кирилл
fire: Monks devised the Cyrillic script for Slavic languages.
Russian signs are printed in Cyrillic, which confused the tourists.
Two brothers, Cyril and Methodius, preached to the Slavs.
The patriarch Kirill gave a speech in Moscow on Sunday.
Church father Cyril of Alexandria opposed Nestorius.
Our neighbor Kirill repaired the fence last weekend.
На встрече выступил Кирилл Петров из Москвы.
Bulgaria adopted the Cyrillic alphabet in the ninth century.
quiet: Monks devised the Gothic script for Germanic languages.

Two brothers, Peter and Andrew, preached to the crowd.
The patriarch Bartholomew gave a speech in Istanbul on Sunday.

notes: Probes: Cyril, Cyrillic, Kirill and Кирилл all fire; Ivan, Мария, Augustine and 'Latin alphabet' do not. The Pyrrh- pieces (Pyrrhic, Pyrrhus, Tyrrhenian) also fire, and Cyrus weakly, so the pole may be a wider early-layer spelling unit for Greek-looking stems; this test covers only the Cyril family.
